theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.restrictInf_ofCompatible
theorems.statement: (ξ : ∀ n, ER n) (hcomp : ∀ (m n : ℕ) (h : m ≤ n), restrict h (ξ n) = ξ m) (n : ℕ) : restrictInf n (ofCompatible ξ hcomp) = ξ n

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.eq_ofCompatible
theorems.statement: {R S : EInf} (h : ∀ n, restrictInf n R = restrictInf n S) : R = S

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.cellIndex_mono

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.filter_sdiff_filter
theorems.statement: (V : Finset ℝ) {u w : ℝ} : (V.filter (fun v => v < w)) \ (V.filter (fun v => v < u)) = V.filter (fun v => u ≤ v ∧ v < w)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.cellIndex_eq_iff
theorems.statement: (V : Finset ℝ) {u w : ℝ} (h : u ≤ w) : cellIndex V u = cellIndex V w ↔ ∀ v ∈ V, ¬ (u ≤ v ∧ v < w)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.intervalRel_iff_no_cut_between
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (V : Finset ℝ) (U : Fin n → ℝ) {i j : Fin n} (h : U i ≤ U j) : (intervalRel V U).r i j ↔ ∀ v ∈ V, ¬ (U i ≤ v ∧ v < U j)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.intervalRel_mono
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} {V W : Finset ℝ} (hVW : V ⊆ W) (U : Fin n → ℝ) : intervalRel W U ≤ intervalRel V U

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.blocks_intervalRel
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (V : Finset ℝ) (U : Fin n → ℝ) (hsurj : ∀ c ≤ V.card, ∃ i : Fin n, cellIndex V (U i) = c) (hle : ∀ i : Fin n, cellIndex V (U i) ≤ V.card) : blocks (intervalRel V U) = V.card + 1

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.jumpProb_eq
theorems.statement: {k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) : jumpProb k = 2 / ((k : ℝ) * ((k : ℝ) - 1))

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.card_covers_mul_jumpProb
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (ξ : ER n) (hk : 2 ≤ blocks ξ) : (Nat.card {η : ER n // Covers ξ η} : ℝ) * jumpProb (blocks ξ) = 1

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.absoluteProb_top
theorems.statement: (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) : absoluteProb n n (Multiset.replicate n 1) = 1

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.jumpCoeff_recursion
theorems.statement: {n k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) (hkn : k ≤ n) : jumpCoeff n k * ((n - k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = 2 * deathRate k * jumpCoeff n (k - 1)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.split_factorials
theorems.statement: {lam nu : ℕ} (h : nu ≤ lam) : ((lam.choose nu * nu ! * (lam - nu)! : ℕ) : ℝ) = (lam ! : ℕ)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.inner_split_sum
theorems.statement: (lam : ℕ) (hlam : 1 ≤ lam) : ∑ nu ∈ Finset.Ico 1 lam, ((lam.choose nu * nu ! * (lam - nu)! : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2 = ((lam : ℝ) - 1) * (lam ! : ℕ) / 2

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.sum_map_mul_const
theorems.statement: (s : Multiset ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℝ) (c : ℝ) : (s.map (fun l => f l * c)).sum = (s.map f).sum * c

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.sum_map_sub_one
theorems.statement: (s : Multiset ℕ) : (s.map (fun l : ℕ => (l : ℝ) - 1)).sum = ((s.sum : ℕ) : ℝ) - (Multiset.card s : ℝ)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.absoluteProb_recursion
theorems.statement: {n k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) (hkn : k ≤ n) (lam : Multiset ℕ) (hcard : Multiset.card lam = k - 1) (hsum : lam.sum = n) : jumpProb k * jumpCoeff n k * (lam.map (fun l : ℕ => ((l : ℝ) - 1) * ((((lam.map Nat.factorial).prod : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2))).sum = absoluteProb n (k - 1) lam

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.jumpKernel_apply
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (ξ : ER n) : jumpKernel n ξ = (jumpLaw ξ).toMeasure

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.jumpKernel_absorbing

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.jumpLaw_apply_cover
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} {ξ η : ER n} (hk : 2 ≤ blocks ξ) (h : Covers ξ η) : jumpLaw ξ η = (((blocks ξ).choose 2 : ℕ) : ENNReal)⁻¹

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.jumpKernel_apply_cover
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (ξ : ER n) (hk : 2 ≤ blocks ξ) (η : {η : ER n // Covers ξ η}) : ((jumpStep ξ hk) η).toReal = jumpProb (blocks ξ)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.lambdaRate_consistent
theorems.statement: (Λ : Measure ℝ) {b k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) (hkb : k ≤ b) (h1 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => x ^ (k - 2) * (1 - x) ^ (b + 1 - k)) Λ) (h2 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => x ^ (k + 1 - 2) * (1 - x) ^ (b + 1 - (k + 1))) Λ) : Blindness.lambdaCoalescentMergerRate Λ b k = Blindness.lambdaCoalescentMergerRate Λ (b + 1) k + Blindness.lambdaCoalescentMergerRate Λ (b + 1) (k + 1)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.kingmanRate_consistent
theorems.statement: : IsConsistentRates kingmanRate

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.lambdaRate_dirac_zero
theorems.statement: {b k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) (hkb : k ≤ b) : Blindness.lambdaCoalescentMergerRate (Measure.dirac 0) b k = kingmanRate b k

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.binaryRate_const_of_consistent
theorems.statement: {lam : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ} (hcons : IsConsistentRates lam) (hbin : ∀ b k, 3 ≤ k → lam b k = 0) {b : ℕ} (hb : 2 ≤ b) : lam b 2 = lam (b + 1) 2

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.binaryRate_eq_base
theorems.statement: {lam : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ} (hcons : IsConsistentRates lam) (hbin : ∀ b k, 3 ≤ k → lam b k = 0) : ∀ b : ℕ, 2 ≤ b → lam b 2 = lam 2 2

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.eq_kingmanRate
theorems.statement: {lam : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ} (hcons : IsConsistentRates lam) (hbin : ∀ b k, 3 ≤ k → lam b k = 0) (hnorm : lam 2 2 = 1) {b k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) (hkb : k ≤ b) : lam b k = kingmanRate b k

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.totalRate_kingman
theorems.statement: {b : ℕ} (hb : 2 ≤ b) : totalRate kingmanRate b = deathRate b

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.exp_neg_mul_holdDensity_eq
theorems.statement: {d θ : ℝ} (hdθ : 0 < d + θ) (t : ℝ) : Real.exp (-(θ * t)) * (d * Real.exp (-(d * t))) = (d / (d + θ)) * ((d + θ) * Real.exp (-((d + θ) * t)))

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.integral_exp_neg_mul_holdDensity

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.integral_exp_neg_mul_holdDensity_zero
theorems.statement: {d : ℝ} (hd : 0 < d) : ∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), Real.exp (-(0 * t)) * (d * Real.exp (-(d * t))) = 1

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.lintegral_exp_neg_holdMeasure
theorems.statement: {d θ : ℝ} (hd : 0 < d) (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) : ∫⁻ t, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(θ * t))) ∂(holdMeasure d) = ENNReal.ofReal (d / (d + θ))

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.coalescentLaw_prod
theorems.statement: (n k m : ℕ) (holdLaw : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure holdLaw] (A : Set (List (ER n))) (B : Set (Fin m → ℝ)) : coalescentLaw n k m holdLaw (A ×ˢ B) = (chainLaw n k).toMeasure A * (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin m => holdLaw) B

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.coalescentLaw_chain_marginal
theorems.statement: (n k m : ℕ) (holdLaw : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure holdLaw] (A : Set (List (ER n))) : coalescentLaw n k m holdLaw (A ×ˢ Set.univ) = (chainLaw n k).toMeasure A

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.coalescentLaw_hold_marginal
theorems.statement: (n k m : ℕ) (holdLaw : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure holdLaw] (B : Set (Fin m → ℝ)) : coalescentLaw n k m holdLaw (Set.univ ×ˢ B) = (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin m => holdLaw) B

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.coalescentLaw_finiteDimensional
theorems.statement: (n k m : ℕ) (holdLaw : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure holdLaw] (A : Set (List (ER n))) (t : ℝ) (j : ℕ) : coalescentLaw n k m holdLaw (A ×ˢ {h : Fin m → ℝ | blockCountAt n (extendHold h) t = j}) = (chainLaw n k).toMeasure A * (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin m => holdLaw) {h | blockCountAt n (extendHold h) t = j}

theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} {α : Type*} (i j : Fin n) (c : Fin n → α) {l : Fin n} (h : l ≠ j) : lookdownApply i j c l = c l

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.norm_sub_mul_pow_le
theorems.statement: {Y : ℕ → 𝔸} {D A : 𝔸} {M eps : ℝ} (hY0 : Y 0 = A) (m : ℕ) (hD : ∀ i, i ≤ m → ‖D ^ i‖ ≤ M) (hrec : ∀ n, n < m → ‖Y (n + 1) - Y n * D‖ ≤ eps) (heps : 0 ≤ eps) : ‖Y m - A * D ^ m‖ ≤ m * eps * M

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.mohle_limit

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.tendsto_restrictionFullProb_two

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.colourIndicator_le_one
theorems.statement: {Z : ℕ → Ω → ℕ} (r i : ℕ) (ω : Ω) : ‖colourIndicator Z r i ω‖ ≤ 1

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.integrable_colourIndicator
theorems.statement: [MeasureSpace Ω] [IsProbabilityMeasure (ℙ : Measure Ω)] {Z : ℕ → Ω → ℕ} (hZ : ∀ i, Measurable (Z i)) (r i : ℕ) : Integrable (colourIndicator Z r i)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.integral_colourIndicator
theorems.statement: [MeasureSpace Ω] [IsProbabilityMeasure (ℙ : Measure Ω)] {Z : ℕ → Ω → ℕ} (hZ : ∀ i, Measurable (Z i)) (r i : ℕ) : ∫ ω, colourIndicator Z r i ω = (ℙ {ω | Z i ω = r}).toReal

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.tendsto_colourFrequency
theorems.statement: [MeasureSpace Ω] [IsProbabilityMeasure (ℙ : Measure Ω)] {Z : ℕ → Ω → ℕ} (hZ : ∀ i, Measurable (Z i)) (hindep : Pairwise fun i j => IndepFun (Z i) (Z j)) (hident : ∀ i, IdentDistrib (Z i) (Z 0)) (r : ℕ) : ∀ᵐ ω, Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ)⁻¹ • ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, colourIndicator Z r i ω) atTop (nhds ((ℙ {ω | Z 0 ω = r}).toReal))

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.tendsto_levelChain_pow
theorems.statement: {Q : 𝔸} (hQ : Q * Q = -Q) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hcN : ∀ N : ℕ, 1 ≤ N → c ≤ (N : ℝ)) (hP : ∀ N : ℕ, ‖(1 : 𝔸) + (c / (N : ℝ)) • Q‖ ≤ 1) (hB : ∀ N : ℕ, ‖(1 : 𝔸) + (1 - Real.exp (-(c / (N : ℝ)))) • Q‖ ≤ 1) : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ ↦ ((1 : 𝔸) + (c / (N : ℝ)) • Q) ^ N) atTop (nhds (1 + (1 - Real.exp (-c)) • Q))

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.sum_pairTime
theorems.statement: (c : Fin 3) (t₃ t₂ : ℝ) : ∑ p : Fin 3, pairTime c p t₃ t₂ = 3 * t₃ + 2 * t₂

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.sum_sq_pairTime
theorems.statement: (c : Fin 3) (t₃ t₂ : ℝ) : ∑ p : Fin 3, pairTime c p t₃ t₂ ^ 2 = t₃ ^ 2 + 2 * (t₃ + t₂) ^ 2

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.cross_pairTime
theorems.statement: (c : Fin 3) (t₃ t₂ : ℝ) : ((∑ p : Fin 3, pairTime c p t₃ t₂) ^ 2 - ∑ p : Fin 3, pairTime c p t₃ t₂ ^ 2) / 2 = 3 * t₃ ^ 2 + 4 * t₃ * t₂ + t₂ ^ 2

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.pairTime_symmetric_sums_topology_free
theorems.statement: (c c' : Fin 3) (t₃ t₂ : ℝ) : (∑ p : Fin 3, pairTime c p t₃ t₂) = (∑ p : Fin 3, pairTime c' p t₃ t₂) ∧ (∑ p : Fin 3, pairTime c p t₃ t₂ ^ 2) = (∑ p : Fin 3, pairTime c' p t₃ t₂ ^ 2)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.expected_cross_pairTime
theorems.statement: {e3 e3sq e2 e2sq e32 : ℝ} (h3 : e3 = 1 / 3) (h3sq : e3sq = 2 / 9) (h2 : e2 = 1) (h2sq : e2sq = 2) (hindep : e32 = e3 * e2) : 3 * e3sq + 4 * e32 + e2sq = 4

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.sum_disjointProducts
theorems.statement: (s : Fin 3) (t₄ t₃ t₂ : ℝ) : pairTime4 s 0 t₄ t₃ t₂ * pairTime4 s 5 t₄ t₃ t₂ + pairTime4 s 1 t₄ t₃ t₂ * pairTime4 s 4 t₄ t₃ t₂ + pairTime4 s 2 t₄ t₃ t₂ * pairTime4 s 3 t₄ t₃ t₂ = if s = 0 then t₄ * (t₄ + t₃) + 2 * (t₄ + t₃ + t₂) ^ 2 else t₄ * (t₄ + t₃ + t₂) + 2 * (t₄ + t₃) * (t₄ + t₃ + t₂)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.sum_over_second_merger
theorems.statement: (t₄ t₃ t₂ : ℝ) : (t₄ * (t₄ + t₃) + 2 * (t₄ + t₃ + t₂) ^ 2) + 2 * (t₄ * (t₄ + t₃ + t₂) + 2 * (t₄ + t₃) * (t₄ + t₃ + t₂)) = 9 * t₄ ^ 2 + 6 * t₃ ^ 2 + 2 * t₂ ^ 2 + 15 * (t₄ * t₃) + 10 * (t₄ * t₂) + 8 * (t₃ * t₂)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.descentTime_self
theorems.statement: (n : ℕ) (hold : ℕ → ℝ) : descentTime n hold n = 0

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.descentTime_antitone
theorems.statement: (n : ℕ) {hold : ℕ → ℝ} (hpos : ∀ j, 0 ≤ hold j) {k k' : ℕ} (h : k ≤ k') : descentTime n hold k' ≤ descentTime n hold k

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.descentTime_nonneg
theorems.statement: (n : ℕ) {hold : ℕ → ℝ} (hpos : ∀ j, 0 ≤ hold j) (k : ℕ) : 0 ≤ descentTime n hold k

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.blockCountAt_antitone
theorems.statement: (n : ℕ) (hold : ℕ → ℝ) {t t' : ℝ} (h : t ≤ t') : blockCountAt n hold t' ≤ blockCountAt n hold t

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.blockCountAt_le
theorems.statement: (n : ℕ) {hold : ℕ → ℝ} {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hn : 1 ≤ n) : blockCountAt n hold t ≤ n

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.one_le_blockCountAt
theorems.statement: (n : ℕ) (hold : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) : 1 ≤ blockCountAt n hold t

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.blockCountAt_zero
theorems.statement: (n : ℕ) {hold : ℕ → ℝ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hpos : ∀ j, 2 ≤ j → j ≤ n → 0 < hold j) : blockCountAt n hold 0 = n

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.blockCountAt_of_transit_le
theorems.statement: (n : ℕ) {hold : ℕ → ℝ} (hpos : ∀ j, 0 ≤ hold j) {t : ℝ} (ht : transitTime n hold ≤ t) : blockCountAt n hold t = 1

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.blockCountAt_le_of_descentTime_le
theorems.statement: (n : ℕ) {hold : ℕ → ℝ} (hpos : ∀ j, 0 ≤ hold j) {t : ℝ} {k : ℕ} (hk1 : 1 ≤ k) (hkn : k ≤ n) (ht : descentTime n hold k ≤ t) : blockCountAt n hold t ≤ k

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.lt_blockCountAt_of_lt_descentTime
theorems.statement: (n : ℕ) {hold : ℕ → ℝ} (hpos : ∀ j, 0 ≤ hold j) {t : ℝ} {k : ℕ} (hk1 : 1 ≤ k) (hkn : k ≤ n) (ht : t < descentTime n hold k) : k < blockCountAt n hold t

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.blockCountAt_eq
theorems.statement: (n : ℕ) {hold : ℕ → ℝ} (hpos : ∀ j, 0 ≤ hold j) {t : ℝ} {k : ℕ} (hk1 : 1 ≤ k) (hkn : k ≤ n) (hle : descentTime n hold k ≤ t) (hlt : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → j < k → t < descentTime n hold j) : blockCountAt n hold t = k

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.extendHold_nonneg
theorems.statement: {m : ℕ} {hold : Fin m → ℝ} (h : ∀ i, 0 ≤ hold i) (j : ℕ) : 0 ≤ extendHold hold j

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.extendHold_apply
theorems.statement: {m : ℕ} (hold : Fin m → ℝ) (i : Fin m) : extendHold hold (i : ℕ) = hold i

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.chain_antitone
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} {chain : ℕ → ER n} (hchain : ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k < n → Covers (chain (k + 1)) (chain k)) {k k' : ℕ} (h1 : 1 ≤ k) (hk : k ≤ k') (hk' : k' ≤ n) : chain k' ≤ chain k

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.blocks_pathState
theorems.statement: (n : ℕ) {chain : ℕ → ER n} {hold : ℕ → ℝ} {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hblocks : ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ n → blocks (chain k) = k) : blocks (pathState n chain hold t) = blockCountAt n hold t

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.pathState_mono
theorems.statement: (n : ℕ) {chain : ℕ → ER n} {hold : ℕ → ℝ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hchain : ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k < n → Covers (chain (k + 1)) (chain k)) {s t : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hst : s ≤ t) : pathState n chain hold s ≤ pathState n chain hold t

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.pathState_zero
theorems.statement: (n : ℕ) {chain : ℕ → ER n} {hold : ℕ → ℝ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hpos : ∀ j, 2 ≤ j → j ≤ n → 0 < hold j) (hstart : chain n = Delta n) : pathState n chain hold 0 = Delta n

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.pathState_of_transit_le

theorems.statement: {N : ℕ} (P : Pedigree N) (x : Fin N) : ancestor P 0 x = x

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.ancestor_succ
theorems.statement: {N : ℕ} (P : Pedigree N) (s : ℕ) (x : Fin N) : ancestor P (s + 1) x = P s (ancestor P s x)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.ancestralRel_rel
theorems.statement: {n N : ℕ} (P : Pedigree N) (sample : Fin n → Fin N) (s : ℕ) (i j : Fin n) : (ancestralRel P sample s).r i j ↔ ancestor P s (sample i) = ancestor P s (sample j)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.ancestralRel_zero
theorems.statement: {n N : ℕ} (P : Pedigree N) {sample : Fin n → Fin N} (hs : Function.Injective sample) : ancestralRel P sample 0 = Delta n

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.ancestralRel_le_succ
theorems.statement: {n N : ℕ} (P : Pedigree N) (sample : Fin n → Fin N) (s : ℕ) : ancestralRel P sample s ≤ ancestralRel P sample (s + 1)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.ancestralRel_monotone
theorems.statement: {n N : ℕ} (P : Pedigree N) (sample : Fin n → Fin N) : Monotone (ancestralRel P sample)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.ancestralRel_eq_top_iff
theorems.statement: {n N : ℕ} (P : Pedigree N) (sample : Fin n → Fin N) (s : ℕ) : ancestralRel P sample s = Theta n ↔ ∀ i j : Fin n, ancestor P s (sample i) = ancestor P s (sample j)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.ancestralRel_eq_top_of_le
theorems.statement: {n N : ℕ} (P : Pedigree N) (sample : Fin n → Fin N) {s t : ℕ} (hst : s ≤ t) (h : ancestralRel P sample s = Theta n) : ancestralRel P sample t = Theta n

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.restrict_ancestralRel
theorems.statement: {m n N : ℕ} (h : m ≤ n) (P : Pedigree N) (sample : Fin n → Fin N) (s : ℕ) : restrict h (ancestralRel P sample s) = ancestralRel P (sample ∘ Fin.castLE h) s

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.ancestralRel_restrict_eq_top
theorems.statement: {m n N : ℕ} (h : m ≤ n) (P : Pedigree N) (sample : Fin n → Fin N) (s : ℕ) (htop : ancestralRel P sample s = Theta n) : ancestralRel P (sample ∘ Fin.castLE h) s = Theta m

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.ancestralRel_one_eq_ancestralPartition
theorems.statement: {n N : ℕ} (P : Pedigree N) (sample : Fin n → Fin N) : ancestralRel P sample 1 = ancestralPartition (fun i ↦ P 0 (sample i))

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.ancestralRel_succ_eq
theorems.statement: {n N : ℕ} (P : Pedigree N) (sample : Fin n → Fin N) (s : ℕ) : ancestralRel P sample (s + 1) = ancestralPartition (fun i ↦ P s (ancestor P s (sample i)))

theorems.statement: (n : ℕ) : ((univ : Finset (Fin (2 * n))).powersetCard n).card = (2 * n).choose n

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.card_allPaths

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.jumpStep_apply
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (ξ : ER n) (hk : 2 ≤ blocks ξ) (η : {η : ER n // Covers ξ η}) : jumpStep ξ hk η = (((blocks ξ).choose 2 : ℕ) : ENNReal)⁻¹

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.jumpStep_apply_eq_jumpProb
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (ξ : ER n) (hk : 2 ≤ blocks ξ) (η : {η : ER n // Covers ξ η}) : (jumpStep ξ hk η).toReal = jumpProb (blocks ξ)

theorems.statement: {lam : ℕ} (h : 1 ≤ lam) : ∑ nu ∈ Finset.Ico 1 lam, lam.choose nu = 2 * (2 ^ (lam - 1) - 1)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.quotientRelation_rel

theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} {ξ η : ER n} (h : ξ ≤ η) : Nat.card (Quotient (quotientRelation h)) = blocks η

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.quotientRelation_self
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (ξ : ER n) : quotientRelation (le_refl ξ) = ⊥

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.blocks_quotientRelation_covers
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} {ξ η : ER n} (hcov : Covers ξ η) : Nat.card (Quotient (quotientRelation hcov.1)) + 1 = blocks ξ

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.hasSum_one_div_deathRate_tail

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.tendsto_survivalFactor_partialProd

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.sum_shift_le
theorems.statement: {u : ℕ → ℝ} (hunn : ∀ n, 0 ≤ u n) (k N : ℕ) : ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc k N, u (n - k) ≤ ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), u m

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.sum_le_of_renewal
theorems.statement: {u f : ℕ → ℝ} {q : ℝ} (hunn : ∀ n, 0 ≤ u n) (hfnn : ∀ n, 0 ≤ f n) (hren : ∀ n, 1 ≤ n → u n = ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, f k * u (n - k)) (hq : ∀ N : ℕ, ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, f k ≤ q) (N : ℕ) : ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), u n ≤ u 0 + q * ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), u m

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.summable_of_renewal
theorems.statement: {u f : ℕ → ℝ} {q : ℝ} (hunn : ∀ n, 0 ≤ u n) (hfnn : ∀ n, 0 ≤ f n) (hren : ∀ n, 1 ≤ n → u n = ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, f k * u (n - k)) (hq : ∀ N : ℕ, ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, f k ≤ q) (hq1 : q < 1) : Summable u

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.tsum_eq_one_of_not_summable
theorems.statement: {u f : ℕ → ℝ} (hunn : ∀ n, 0 ≤ u n) (hfnn : ∀ n, 0 ≤ f n) (hf0 : f 0 = 0) (hf : Summable f) (hf1 : ∑' k, f k ≤ 1) (hren : ∀ n, 1 ≤ n → u n = ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, f k * u (n - k)) (hns : ¬ Summable u) : ∑' k, f k = 1

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.polya_certain_return
theorems.statement: {f : ℕ → ℝ} (hfnn : ∀ n, 0 ≤ f n) (hf0 : f 0 = 0) (hf : Summable f) (hf1 : ∑' k, f k ≤ 1) (hren : ∀ n, 1 ≤ n → returnProb n = ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, f k * returnProb (n - k)) : ∑' k, f k = 1

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.returnProb_zero
theorems.statement: : returnProb 0 = 1

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.restrict_rel
theorems.statement: {m n : ℕ} (h : m ≤ n) (ξ : ER n) (x y : Fin m) : (restrict h ξ).r x y ↔ ξ.r (Fin.castLE h x) (Fin.castLE h y)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.restrict_restrict
theorems.statement: {l m n : ℕ} (h1 : l ≤ m) (h2 : m ≤ n) (ξ : ER n) : restrict h1 (restrict h2 ξ) = restrict (le_trans h1 h2) ξ

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.restrict_mono
theorems.statement: {m n : ℕ} (h : m ≤ n) {ξ η : ER n} (hle : ξ ≤ η) : restrict h ξ ≤ restrict h η

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.restrict_bot
theorems.statement: {m n : ℕ} (h : m ≤ n) : restrict h (Delta n) = Delta m

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.restrict_top
theorems.statement: {m n : ℕ} (h : m ≤ n) : restrict h (Theta n) = Theta m

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.blocks_restrict_le
theorems.statement: {m n : ℕ} (h : m ≤ n) (ξ : ER n) : blocks (restrict h ξ) ≤ blocks ξ

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.sum_inv_diff_ge
theorems.statement: {gam : ℕ → ℝ} (hpos : ∀ b : ℕ, 2 ≤ b → 0 < gam b) (hmono : ∀ i j : ℕ, 2 ≤ i → i ≤ j → gam i ≤ gam j) {c b : ℕ} (hc : 1 ≤ c) (hcb : c ≤ b) : ((b : ℝ) - (c : ℝ)) / gam b ≤ (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 2 b, 1 / gam j) - ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 2 c, 1 / gam j

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.meanTime_le_sum
theorems.statement: {h gam lamb : ℕ → ℝ} {p : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ} (hpos : ∀ b : ℕ, 2 ≤ b → 0 < gam b) (hmono : ∀ i j : ℕ, 2 ≤ i → i ≤ j → gam i ≤ gam j) (hlamb : ∀ b : ℕ, 2 ≤ b → 0 < lamb b) (hp0 : ∀ b k : ℕ, 0 ≤ p b k) (hp1 : ∀ b : ℕ, 2 ≤ b → ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 b, p b k = 1) (hdrift : ∀ b : ℕ, 2 ≤ b → ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 b, ((k : ℝ) - 1) * p b k = gam b / lamb b) (h1 : h 1 = 0) (hrec : ∀ b : ℕ, 2 ≤ b → h b = 1 / lamb b + ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 b, p b k * h (b - k + 1)) (b : ℕ) (hb : 1 ≤ b) : h b ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 2 b, 1 / gam j

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.meanTime_bddAbove
theorems.statement: {h gam lamb : ℕ → ℝ} {p : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ} (hpos : ∀ b : ℕ, 2 ≤ b → 0 < gam b) (hmono : ∀ i j : ℕ, 2 ≤ i → i ≤ j → gam i ≤ gam j) (hlamb : ∀ b : ℕ, 2 ≤ b → 0 < lamb b) (hp0 : ∀ b k : ℕ, 0 ≤ p b k) (hp1 : ∀ b : ℕ, 2 ≤ b → ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 b, p b k = 1) (hdrift : ∀ b : ℕ, 2 ≤ b → ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 b, ((k : ℝ) - 1) * p b k = gam b / lamb b) (h1 : h 1 = 0) (hrec : ∀ b : ℕ, 2 ≤ b → h b = 1 / lamb b + ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 b, p b k * h (b - k + 1)) (hcdi : comesDownFromInfinity gam) : ∀ b, 1 ≤ b → h b ≤ ∑' i : ℕ, 1 / gam (i + 2)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.schweinsberg_comesDownFromInfinity
theorems.statement: {h lamb : ℕ → ℝ} {lam : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ} {p : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ} (hpos : ∀ b : ℕ, 2 ≤ b → 0 < decreaseRate lam b) (hmono : ∀ i j : ℕ, 2 ≤ i → i ≤ j → decreaseRate lam i ≤ decreaseRate lam j) (hlamb : ∀ b : ℕ, 2 ≤ b → 0 < lamb b) (hp0 : ∀ b k : ℕ, 0 ≤ p b k) (hp1 : ∀ b : ℕ, 2 ≤ b → ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 b, p b k = 1) (hdrift : ∀ b : ℕ, 2 ≤ b → ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 b, ((k : ℝ) - 1) * p b k = decreaseRate lam b / lamb b) (h1 : h 1 = 0) (hrec : ∀ b : ℕ, 2 ≤ b → h b = 1 / lamb b + ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 b, p b k * h (b - k + 1)) (hcdi : comesDownFromInfinity (decreaseRate lam)) : ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ b, 1 ≤ b → h b ≤ M

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.firstStep_active
theorems.statement: {c r : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (hr : 0 < r) : meanTimeActive c r = 1 / (1 + 2 * c) + (2 * c / (1 + 2 * c)) * meanTimeDormant c r

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.firstStep_dormant
theorems.statement: (c r : ℝ) : meanTimeDormant c r = 1 / r + meanTimeActive c r

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.meanTimeActive_eq
theorems.statement: (c r : ℝ) : meanTimeActive c r = 1 + 2 * c / r

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.meanTimeActive_gt_one
theorems.statement: {c r : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (hr : 0 < r) : 1 < meanTimeActive c r

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.meanTimeActive_zero_dormancy
theorems.statement: (r : ℝ) : meanTimeActive 0 r = 1

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.meanTimeActive_eq_of_ratio
theorems.statement: {c r c' r' : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hr' : 0 < r') (h : c / r = c' / r') : meanTimeActive c r = meanTimeActive c' r'

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.meanTimeDormant_sub_meanTimeActive
theorems.statement: (c r : ℝ) : meanTimeDormant c r - meanTimeActive c r = 1 / r

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.expectedSegregatingSites_eq
theorems.statement: (θ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : expectedSegregatingSites θ n = θ * harmonicSum (n - 1)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.expectedSegregatingSites_one
theorems.statement: (θ : ℝ) : expectedSegregatingSites θ 1 = 0

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.expectedSegregatingSites_two
theorems.statement: (θ : ℝ) : expectedSegregatingSites θ 2 = θ

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.expectedSegregatingSites_nonneg
theorems.statement: {θ : ℝ} (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ expectedSegregatingSites θ n

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.harmonicSum_pos_of_two_le
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) : 0 < harmonicSum (n - 1)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.wattersonEstimator_unbiased
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (θ : ℝ) : wattersonEstimator (expectedSegregatingSites θ n) n = θ

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.expectedPairwiseDifferences_eq
theorems.statement: (θ : ℝ) : expectedPairwiseDifferences θ = θ

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.expectedTajimaNumerator_eq_zero
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (θ : ℝ) : expectedTajimaNumerator θ n = 0

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.tendsto_expectedSegregatingSites_atTop
theorems.statement: {θ : ℝ} (hθ : 0 < θ) : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ ↦ expectedSegregatingSites θ (n + 1)) atTop atTop

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.variantDiscovery_unbounded
theorems.statement: {θ : ℝ} (hθ : 0 < θ) (B : ℝ) : (∀ n : ℕ, meanTransitTime n < 2) ∧ ∃ n : ℕ, B < expectedSegregatingSites θ n

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.asgEventRate_zero_selection
theorems.statement: (k : ℕ) : asgEventRate k 0 = deathRate k

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.branchDeathRatio_eq
theorems.statement: {k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) (sigma : ℝ) : branchRate k sigma / deathRate k = sigma / ((k : ℝ) - 1)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.tendsto_branchDeathRatio
theorems.statement: (sigma : ℝ) : Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => sigma / ((k : ℝ) + 1)) atTop (nhds 0)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.branchRate_lt_deathRate
theorems.statement: {k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) {sigma : ℝ} (hsig : 0 < sigma) (hlarge : sigma < (k : ℝ) - 1) : branchRate k sigma < deathRate k

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.branchRate_zero
theorems.statement: (k : ℕ) : branchRate k 0 = 0

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.deathRate_le_asgEventRate
theorems.statement: {k : ℕ} {sigma : ℝ} (hsig : 0 ≤ sigma) : deathRate k ≤ asgEventRate k sigma

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.norm_pow_sub_pow_le
theorems.statement: {M : Type*} [NormedRing M] [NormOneClass M] (A B : M) (hA : ‖A‖ ≤ 1) (hB : ‖B‖ ≤ 1) (r : ℕ) : ‖A ^ r - B ^ r‖ ≤ (r : ℝ) * ‖A - B‖

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.exp_smul_pow_self
theorems.statement: {𝔸 : Type*} [NormedRing 𝔸] [NormedAlgebra ℝ 𝔸] [CompleteSpace 𝔸] (Q : 𝔸) {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) : exp ℝ ((1 / (N : ℝ)) • Q) ^ N = exp ℝ Q

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.tendsto_pow_of_close
theorems.statement: {𝔸 : Type*} [NormedRing 𝔸] [NormOneClass 𝔸] (L : 𝔸) (C : ℝ) (P B : ℕ → 𝔸) (hP : ∀ N, ‖P N‖ ≤ 1) (hB : ∀ N, ‖B N‖ ≤ 1) (hpow : ∀ N : ℕ, 1 ≤ N → B N ^ N = L) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hclose : ∀ᶠ N in atTop, ‖P N - B N‖ ≤ C / (N : ℝ) ^ 2) : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ ↦ P N ^ N) atTop (nhds L)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.tendsto_pow_self_exp
theorems.statement: {𝔸 : Type*} [NormedRing 𝔸] [NormOneClass 𝔸] [NormedAlgebra ℝ 𝔸] [CompleteSpace 𝔸] (Q : 𝔸) (C : ℝ) (P : ℕ → 𝔸) (hP : ∀ N, ‖P N‖ ≤ 1) (hE : ∀ N : ℕ, ‖exp ℝ ((1 / (N : ℝ)) • Q)‖ ≤ 1) (hclose : ∀ N, ‖P N - exp ℝ ((1 / (N : ℝ)) • Q)‖ ≤ C / (N : ℝ) ^ 2) : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ ↦ P N ^ N) atTop (nhds (exp ℝ Q))

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.norm_exp_smul_sub_one_le_one
theorems.statement: {𝔸 : Type*} [NormedRing 𝔸] [NormOneClass 𝔸] [NormedAlgebra ℝ 𝔸] [CompleteSpace 𝔸] (S : 𝔸) (hS : ‖S‖ ≤ 1) (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) : ‖exp ℝ (a • (S - 1))‖ ≤ 1

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.tendsto_pow_of_expansion
theorems.statement: {𝔸 : Type*} [NormedRing 𝔸] [NormOneClass 𝔸] [NormedAlgebra ℝ 𝔸] [CompleteSpace 𝔸] (Q : 𝔸) (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (P : ℕ → 𝔸) (hP : ∀ N : ℕ, ‖P N‖ ≤ 1) (hE : ∀ N : ℕ, ‖exp ℝ ((1 / (N : ℝ)) • Q)‖ ≤ 1) (hclose : ∀ᶠ N in atTop, ‖P N - (1 + (1 / (N : ℝ)) • Q)‖ ≤ C / (N : ℝ) ^ 2) : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ ↦ P N ^ N) atTop (nhds (exp ℝ Q))

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.expectedSpectrum_eq
theorems.statement: (θ : ℝ) (i : ℕ) : expectedSpectrum θ i = θ / (i : ℝ)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.sum_spectrumBranchLength
theorems.statement: (n : ℕ) : ∑ j ∈ range (n - 1), spectrumBranchLength (j + 1) = expectedTotalBranchLength n

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.sum_expectedSpectrum
theorems.statement: (θ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ∑ j ∈ range (n - 1), expectedSpectrum θ (j + 1) = expectedSegregatingSites θ n

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.spectrum_shape_independent_of_theta
theorems.statement: (θ : ℝ) (j : ℕ) : expectedSpectrum θ (j + 1) * ((j : ℝ) + 1) = θ

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.spectrum_ratio
theorems.statement: (θ : ℝ) (j : ℕ) : expectedSpectrum θ (j + 1) * ((j : ℝ) + 1) = expectedSpectrum θ 1

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.singletonShare_eq
theorems.statement: {θ : ℝ} (hθ : θ ≠ 0) {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) : expectedSpectrum θ 1 / expectedSegregatingSites θ n = 1 / harmonicSum (n - 1)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.voterConfig_eq_ancestor
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} {α : Type*} (u : ℕ → Fin n × Fin n) (c₀ : Fin n → α) (t : ℕ) : voterConfig u c₀ t = c₀ ∘ voterAncestor u t

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.voterConfig_eq_iff
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} {α : Type*} (u : ℕ → Fin n × Fin n) (c₀ : Fin n → α) (t : ℕ) (x y : Fin n) (hinj : Function.Injective c₀) : voterConfig u c₀ t x = voterConfig u c₀ t y ↔ voterAncestor u t x = voterAncestor u t y

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.voterAncestralRel_zero
theorems.statement: {m n : ℕ} (u : ℕ → Fin n × Fin n) {sample : Fin m → Fin n} (hs : Function.Injective sample) : voterAncestralRel u sample 0 = Delta m

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.voterAncestralRel_le_succ
theorems.statement: {m n : ℕ} (u : ℕ → Fin n × Fin n) (sample : Fin m → Fin n) (s : ℕ) : voterAncestralRel u sample s ≤ voterAncestralRel u sample (s + 1)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.restrict_voterAncestralRel
theorems.statement: {l m n : ℕ} (h : l ≤ m) (u : ℕ → Fin n × Fin n) (sample : Fin m → Fin n) (s : ℕ) : restrict h (voterAncestralRel u sample s) = voterAncestralRel u (sample ∘ Fin.castLE h) s

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.walk_zero
theorems.statement: (x₀ : ℤ) (step : ℕ → ℤ) : walk x₀ step 0 = x₀

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.walk_succ
theorems.statement: (x₀ : ℤ) (step : ℕ → ℤ) (t : ℕ) : walk x₀ step (t + 1) = walk x₀ step t + step t

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.walk_sub
theorems.statement: (x₀ y₀ : ℤ) (ξ η : ℕ → ℤ) (t : ℕ) : walk x₀ ξ t - walk y₀ η t = walk (x₀ - y₀) (fun s ↦ ξ s - η s) t

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.meet_iff_difference_walk_zero
theorems.statement: (x₀ y₀ : ℤ) (ξ η : ℕ → ℤ) (t : ℕ) : walk x₀ ξ t = walk y₀ η t ↔ walk (x₀ - y₀) (fun s ↦ ξ s - η s) t = 0

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.walk_zero_step
theorems.statement: (x₀ : ℤ) (t : ℕ) : walk x₀ (fun _ ↦ 0) t = x₀

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.harmonicSumSq_zero
theorems.statement: : harmonicSumSq 0 = 0

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.harmonicSumSq_succ
theorems.statement: (m : ℕ) : harmonicSumSq (m + 1) = harmonicSumSq m + 1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.harmonicSumSq_nonneg
theorems.statement: (m : ℕ) : 0 ≤ harmonicSumSq m

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.harmonicSumSq_le
theorems.statement: {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) : harmonicSumSq m ≤ 2 - 1 / (m : ℝ)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.harmonicSumSq_le_two
theorems.statement: (m : ℕ) : harmonicSumSq m ≤ 2

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.varTotalBranchLength_eq
theorems.statement: (n : ℕ) : varTotalBranchLength n = 4 * harmonicSumSq (n - 1)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.varTotalBranchLength_nonneg
theorems.statement: (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ varTotalBranchLength n

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.varTotalBranchLength_le_eight
theorems.statement: (n : ℕ) : varTotalBranchLength n ≤ 8

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.varSegregatingSites_eq_totalVariance
theorems.statement: (θ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : varSegregatingSites θ n = θ / 2 * expectedTotalBranchLength n + (θ / 2) ^ 2 * varTotalBranchLength n

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.varSegregatingSites_nonneg
theorems.statement: {θ : ℝ} (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ varSegregatingSites θ n

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.varWattersonEstimator_le
theorems.statement: {θ : ℝ} (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ harmonicSum (n - 1)) : varWattersonEstimator θ n ≤ (θ + 2 * θ ^ 2) / harmonicSum (n - 1)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.exists_varWattersonEstimator_lt
theorems.statement: {θ : ℝ} (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) : ∃ n : ℕ, varWattersonEstimator θ n < ε

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.varPairwise_two_eq
theorems.statement: (θ : ℝ) : tajimaVarPairwise θ 2 = varSegregatingSites θ 2

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.splitBy_rel_iff
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (η : ER n) (S : Finset (Fin n)) (x y : Fin n) : (splitBy η S).r x y ↔ (η.r x y ∧ (x ∈ S ↔ y ∈ S))

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.splitBy_le
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (η : ER n) (S : Finset (Fin n)) : splitBy η S ≤ η

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.range_splitMap
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (η : ER n) (S : Finset (Fin n)) {a : Fin n} (hSa : ∀ x ∈ S, η.r x a) (hSne : ∃ x, x ∈ S) (hSproper : ∃ x, η.r x a ∧ x ∉ S) : Set.range (fun x : Fin n => (Quotient.mk η x, decide (x ∈ S))) = {p | p.2 = false} ∪ {(Quotient.mk η a, true)}

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.blocks_splitBy
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (η : ER n) (S : Finset (Fin n)) {a : Fin n} (hSa : ∀ x ∈ S, η.r x a) (hSne : ∃ x, x ∈ S) (hSproper : ∃ x, η.r x a ∧ x ∉ S) : blocks (splitBy η S) = blocks η + 1

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.splitBy_covers
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (η : ER n) (S : Finset (Fin n)) {a : Fin n} (hSa : ∀ x ∈ S, η.r x a) (hSne : ∃ x, x ∈ S) (hSproper : ∃ x, η.r x a ∧ x ∉ S) : Covers (splitBy η S) η

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.eq_splitBy_merge
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (ξ : ER n) {a b : Quotient ξ} (hab : a ≠ b) : ξ = splitBy (merge ξ a b) (Finset.univ.filter fun x => Quotient.mk ξ x = a)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.covers_iff_exists_splitBy
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (ξ η : ER n) : Covers ξ η ↔ ∃ S : Finset (Fin n), ξ = splitBy η S ∧ Covers (splitBy η S) η

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.splitBy_compl
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (η : ER n) (S : Finset (Fin n)) (a : Fin n) (hSa : ∀ x ∈ S, η.r x a) : splitBy η S = splitBy η ((Finset.univ.filter fun z => η.r z a) \ S)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.exists_rel_ne_of_ne_bot
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} {ξ : ER n} (h : ξ ≠ Delta n) : ∃ x y : Fin n, x ≠ y ∧ ξ.r x y

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.exists_covers_of_ne_bot
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} {ξ : ER n} (h : ξ ≠ Delta n) : ∃ ξ' : ER n, Covers ξ' ξ

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.splitBy_eq_iff
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (η : ER n) (S T : Finset (Fin n)) : splitBy η S = splitBy η T ↔ ∀ x y : Fin n, η.r x y → ((x ∈ S ↔ y ∈ S) ↔ (x ∈ T ↔ y ∈ T))

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.quotient_mk_surjective
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (ξ : ER n) : Function.Surjective (Quotient.mk ξ)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.blocks_bot
theorems.statement: (n : ℕ) : blocks (Delta n) = n

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.blocks_top
theorems.statement: (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] : blocks (Theta n) = 1

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.blocks_eq_one_iff
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (ξ : ER n) : blocks ξ = 1 ↔ ξ = Theta n

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.blocks_pos
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (ξ : ER n) : 0 < blocks ξ

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.blockMap_surjective
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} {ξ η : ER n} (h : ξ ≤ η) : Function.Surjective (blockMap h)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.mergeMap_apply_of_ne
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (ξ : ER n) (a b c : Quotient ξ) (h : c ≠ b) : mergeMap ξ a b c = c

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.mergeMap_apply_self
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (ξ : ER n) (a b : Quotient ξ) : mergeMap ξ a b b = a

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.mergeMap_eq_iff
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (ξ : ER n) {a b : Quotient ξ} (hab : a ≠ b) (x y : Quotient ξ) : mergeMap ξ a b x = mergeMap ξ a b y ↔ x = y ∨ (x = a ∧ y = b) ∨ (x = b ∧ y = a)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.le_merge
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (ξ : ER n) (a b : Quotient ξ) : ξ ≤ merge ξ a b

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.merge_rel
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (ξ : ER n) (a b : Quotient ξ) {x y : Fin n} (hx : Quotient.mk ξ x = a) (hy : Quotient.mk ξ y = b) : (merge ξ a b).r x y

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.range_mergeMap
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (ξ : ER n) {a b : Quotient ξ} (hab : a ≠ b) : Set.range (fun x : Fin n => mergeMap ξ a b (Quotient.mk ξ x)) = {c | c ≠ b}

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.blocks_merge
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (ξ : ER n) {a b : Quotient ξ} (hab : a ≠ b) : blocks (merge ξ a b) + 1 = blocks ξ

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.merge_covers
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (ξ : ER n) {a b : Quotient ξ} (hab : a ≠ b) : Covers ξ (merge ξ a b)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.eq_of_le_of_blocks_eq
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} {ξ η : ER n} (h : ξ ≤ η) (hb : blocks ξ = blocks η) : ξ = η

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.covers_iff_exists_merge
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (ξ η : ER n) : Covers ξ η ↔ ∃ a b : Quotient ξ, a ≠ b ∧ η = merge ξ a b

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.merge_comm
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (ξ : ER n) {a b : Quotient ξ} (hab : a ≠ b) : merge ξ a b = merge ξ b a

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.merge_eq_merge_iff
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (ξ : ER n) {a b c d : Quotient ξ} (hab : a ≠ b) (hcd : c ≠ d) : merge ξ a b = merge ξ c d ↔ ({a, b} : Finset (Quotient ξ)) = {c, d}

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.pair_spec
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} {ξ : ER n} {s : Finset (Quotient ξ)} (h : s.card = 2) : pairFst h ≠ pairSnd h ∧ s = {pairFst h, pairSnd h}

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.coverOfPair_bijective
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (ξ : ER n) : Function.Bijective (coverOfPair ξ)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.card_covers
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (ξ : ER n) : Nat.card {η : ER n // Covers ξ η} = (blocks ξ).choose 2

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.two_mul_choose_two
theorems.statement: (k : ℕ) : 2 * k.choose 2 = k * (k - 1)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.card_covers_eq_deathRate
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (ξ : ER n) : (Nat.card {η : ER n // Covers ξ η} : ℝ) = deathRate (blocks ξ)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.stepLaw_prod
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (ξ : ER n) (hk : 2 ≤ blocks ξ) (A : Set {η : ER n // Covers ξ η}) (B : Set ℝ) : stepLaw ξ hk (A ×ˢ B) = (jumpStep ξ hk).toMeasure A * holdMeasure (deathRate (blocks ξ)) B

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.stepLaw_destination_marginal
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (ξ : ER n) (hk : 2 ≤ blocks ξ) (A : Set {η : ER n // Covers ξ η}) : stepLaw ξ hk (A ×ˢ Set.univ) = (jumpStep ξ hk).toMeasure A

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.stepLaw_time_marginal
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (ξ : ER n) (hk : 2 ≤ blocks ξ) (B : Set ℝ) : stepLaw ξ hk (Set.univ ×ˢ B) = holdMeasure (deathRate (blocks ξ)) B

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.stepLaw_destination_uniform
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (ξ : ER n) (hk : 2 ≤ blocks ξ) (η : {η : ER n // Covers ξ η}) : ((jumpStep ξ hk) η).toReal = jumpProb (blocks ξ)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.firstStep_same

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.firstStep_diff

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.meanTimeSame_eq_two

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.meanTimeSame_eq_two_mul_meanTransitTime

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.fstFromMigration_eq_proportionalReduction

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.fstFromMigration_ne_proportionalReduction_at_zero

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.fstFromMigration_eq
theorems.statement: {M : ℝ} (hM : 0 < M) : fstFromMigration M = 1 / (1 + 2 * M)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.fstFromMigration_antitone
theorems.statement: {M M' : ℝ} (hM : 0 < M) (h : M ≤ M') : fstFromMigration M' ≤ fstFromMigration M

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.tendsto_fstFromMigration
theorems.statement: : Tendsto (fun M : ℝ => fstFromMigration M) atTop (nhds 0)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.sum_sharedPath3
theorems.statement: (c : Fin 3) (t₃ t₂ : ℝ) : sharedPath3 c 0 1 t₃ t₂ + sharedPath3 c 0 2 t₃ t₂ + sharedPath3 c 1 2 t₃ t₂ = 3 * t₃ + 2 * t₂

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.sum_sharedPath3_eq_sum_pairTime
theorems.statement: (c c' : Fin 3) (t₃ t₂ : ℝ) : sharedPath3 c 0 1 t₃ t₂ + sharedPath3 c 0 2 t₃ t₂ + sharedPath3 c 1 2 t₃ t₂ = ∑ p : Fin 3, pairTime c' p t₃ t₂

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.sum_sharedPath4
theorems.statement: (s : Fin 3) (t₃ t₂ : ℝ) : sharedPath4 s 0 t₃ t₂ + sharedPath4 s 1 t₃ t₂ + sharedPath4 s 2 t₃ t₂ = if s = 0 then 2 * t₃ + 4 * t₂ else 2 * t₃

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.count_split
theorems.statement: (n : ℝ) : sharingCount n + disjointCount n = pairCount n * (pairCount n - 1) / 2

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.varPairwiseFromTree_eq_tajima
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (θ : ℝ) : varPairwiseFromTree θ (n : ℝ) = tajimaVarPairwise θ n

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.varPairwiseFromTree_two
theorems.statement: (θ : ℝ) : varPairwiseFromTree θ (2 : ℝ) = varSegregatingSites θ 2

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.prod_le_exp_neg_sum
theorems.statement: (a : ℕ → ℝ) (h0 : ∀ k, 0 ≤ a k) (h1 : ∀ k, a k ≤ 1) (m : ℕ) : ∏ k ∈ range m, (1 - a k) ≤ Real.exp (-∑ k ∈ range m, a k)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.prod_ratio_le_exp
theorems.statement: {γ : ℕ → ℝ} (hγ : ∀ k, 1 ≤ γ (k + 2)) (m : ℕ) : ∏ k ∈ range m, (γ (k + 2) / (γ (k + 2) + 1)) ≤ Real.exp (-∑ k ∈ range m, 1 / (γ (k + 2) + 1))

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.tendsto_sum_inv_succ_atTop
theorems.statement: {γ : ℕ → ℝ} (hγ : ∀ k, 1 ≤ γ (k + 2)) (h : ¬ comesDownFromInfinity γ) : Tendsto (fun m : ℕ ↦ ∑ k ∈ range m, 1 / (γ (k + 2) + 1)) atTop atTop

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.tendsto_prod_ratio_zero
theorems.statement: {γ : ℕ → ℝ} (hγ : ∀ k, 1 ≤ γ (k + 2)) (h : ¬ comesDownFromInfinity γ) : Tendsto (fun m : ℕ ↦ ∏ k ∈ range m, (γ (k + 2) / (γ (k + 2) + 1))) atTop (nhds 0)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.holdMeasure_nonpos
theorems.statement: {d : ℝ} : holdMeasure d {t : ℝ | t ≤ 0} = 0

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.ae_holdProduct_pos
theorems.statement: {γ : ℕ → ℝ} (hγ : ∀ k, 0 < γ (k + 2)) : ∀ᵐ ω ∂(holdProduct γ hγ), ∀ k : ℕ, 0 < ω k

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.clippedTransform_measurable
theorems.statement: (m : ℕ) : Measurable (clippedTransform m)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.clippedTransform_antitone
theorems.statement: : Antitone clippedTransform

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.lintegral_clippedTransform
theorems.statement: {γ : ℕ → ℝ} (hγ : ∀ k, 0 < γ (k + 2)) (m : ℕ) : ∫⁻ ω, clippedTransform m ω ∂(holdProduct γ hγ) = ∏ k ∈ range m, ENNReal.ofReal (γ (k + 2) / (γ (k + 2) + 1))

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.ae_totalDescentTime_eq_top
theorems.statement: {γ : ℕ → ℝ} (hγ1 : ∀ k, 1 ≤ γ (k + 2)) (h : ¬ comesDownFromInfinity γ) : ∀ᵐ ω ∂(holdProduct γ (fun k ↦ lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (hγ1 k))), (∑' k : ℕ, ENNReal.ofReal (ω k)) = ⊤

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.ae_descent_dichotomy
theorems.statement: {γ : ℕ → ℝ} (hγ1 : ∀ k, 1 ≤ γ (k + 2)) : (comesDownFromInfinity γ → ∀ᵐ ω ∂(holdProduct γ (fun k ↦ lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (hγ1 k))), (∑' k : ℕ, ENNReal.ofReal (ω k)) < ⊤) ∧ (¬ comesDownFromInfinity γ → ∀ᵐ ω ∂(holdProduct γ (fun k ↦ lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (hγ1 k))), (∑' k : ℕ, ENNReal.ofReal (ω k)) = ⊤)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.star_ae_totalDescentTime_eq_top
theorems.statement: : ∀ᵐ ω ∂(holdProduct (fun b : ℕ ↦ (b : ℝ) - 1) (fun k ↦ lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (by push_cast; linarith))), (∑' k : ℕ, ENNReal.ofReal (ω k)) = ⊤

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.mem_support_jumpLaw
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} {ξ η : ER n} (hk : 2 ≤ blocks ξ) : η ∈ (jumpLaw ξ).support ↔ Covers ξ η

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.chainLaw_length
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (k : ℕ) {l : List (ER n)} (hl : l ∈ (chainLaw n k).support) : l.length = k + 1

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.chainLaw_getLast
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (k : ℕ) {l : List (ER n)} (hl : l ∈ (chainLaw n k).support) : l.getLast? = some (Delta n)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.chainLaw_support_chain'
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (k : ℕ) {l : List (ER n)} (hl : l ∈ (chainLaw n k).support) : List.Chain' (fun y x => Covers x y ∨ y = x) l

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.chainLaw_head_blocks
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} : ∀ (k : ℕ), k < n → ∀ {l : List (ER n)}, l ∈ (chainLaw n k).support → ∀ {x : ER n}, l.head? = some x → blocks x + k = n

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.blocks_of_mem_support_blockLaw
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} {k : ℕ} (hk : k < n) {x : ER n} (hx : x ∈ (blockLaw n k).support) : blocks x + k = n

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.chainLaw_blocks_at
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} : ∀ (k : ℕ), k < n → ∀ {l : List (ER n)}, l ∈ (chainLaw n k).support → ∀ i, i < l.length → blocks (l.getD i (Delta n)) = n - k + i

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.blocks_chainOfList
theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) {l : List (ER n)} (hl : l ∈ (chainLaw n (n - 1)).support) {k : ℕ} (hk1 : 1 ≤ k) (hkn : k ≤ n) : blocks (chainOfList l k) = k

theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hn : 2 ≤ n) {l : List (ER n)} (hl : l ∈ (chainLaw n (n - 1)).support) {x : ER n} (hx : l.head? = some x) : x = Theta n

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.chainTraj_restrict_zero
theorems.statement: (n : ℕ) : (chainTraj n).map (Preorder.frestrictLe 0) = Kernel.id

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.indep_holdCoords
theorems.statement: {γ : ℕ → ℝ} (hγ : ∀ k, 0 < γ (k + 2)) (θ : ℝ) : iIndepFun (fun (k : ℕ) (ω : ℕ → ℝ) ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(θ * ω k)))) (holdProduct γ hγ)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.lintegral_exp_neg_partialSum
theorems.statement: {γ : ℕ → ℝ} (hγ : ∀ k, 0 < γ (k + 2)) {θ : ℝ} (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) (m : ℕ) : ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(θ * ∑ k ∈ range m, ω k))) ∂(holdProduct γ hγ) = ∏ k ∈ range m, ENNReal.ofReal (γ (k + 2) / (γ (k + 2) + θ))

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.kingman_transitTransform
theorems.statement: {θ : ℝ} (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) (m : ℕ) : ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(θ * ∑ k ∈ range m, ω k))) ∂(holdProduct deathRate (fun k ↦ deathRate_pos (by omega))) = ∏ k ∈ range m, ENNReal.ofReal (deathRate (k + 2) / (deathRate (k + 2) + θ))

theorems.statement: (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ varTransitTime n

theorems.statement: (k : ℕ) : (1 : ℝ) ≤ deathRate (k + 2)

theorems.statement: (k : ℕ) : 1 / deathRate (k + 2) ≤ 1

theorems.statement: (n : ℕ) : varTransitTime n ≤ meanTransitTime n

theorems.statement: (n : ℕ) : varTransitTime n < 2

theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) : 1 ≤ varTransitTime n

theorems.statement: {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) : meanTransitTime n ^ 2 / 4 < varTransitTime n

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.varTransitTime_two
theorems.statement: : varTransitTime 2 = 1

theorems.statement: {s : Set EInf} (hs : s ∈ cylinders) : MeasurableSet[cylinderSpace] s

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.cylinderSpace_eq_generateFrom
theorems.statement: : cylinderSpace = MeasurableSpace.generateFrom cylinders

theorems.statement: (μ ν : @MeasureTheory.Measure EInf cylinderSpace) (hμ : @MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure _ cylinderSpace μ) (hν : @MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure _ cylinderSpace ν) (h : ∀ (n : ℕ) (ξ : ER n), μ ((restrictInf n) ⁻¹' {ξ}) = ν ((restrictInf n) ⁻¹' {ξ})) : μ = ν

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.relativeSize_zero
theorems.statement: (β : ℝ) : relativeSize β 0 = 1

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.relativeSize_pos
theorems.statement: (β t : ℝ) : 0 < relativeSize β t

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.relativeSize_le_one
theorems.statement: {β t : ℝ} (hβ : 0 ≤ β) (ht : 0 ≤ t) : relativeSize β t ≤ 1

theorems.statement: (β : ℝ) : timeChange β 0 = 0

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.deriv_timeChange_eq_deathRate_div
theorems.statement: {β : ℝ} (hβ : β ≠ 0) (t : ℝ) : deriv (timeChange β) t = deathRate 2 / relativeSize β t

theorems.statement: {β : ℝ} (hβ : β ≠ 0) (t : ℝ) (k : ℕ) : deathRate k * deriv (timeChange β) t = deathRate k / relativeSize β t

theorems.statement: {β : ℝ} (hβ : 0 < β) : StrictMono (timeChange β)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.timeChange_ge
theorems.statement: {β : ℝ} (hβ : 0 < β) (t : ℝ) : t ≤ timeChange β t

theorems.statement: (β : ℝ) : pairSurvival β 0 = 1

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.pairSurvival_le_constant
theorems.statement: {β : ℝ} (hβ : 0 < β) (t : ℝ) : pairSurvival β t ≤ Real.exp (-t)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.timeChange_tendsto_atTop
theorems.statement: {β : ℝ} (hβ : 0 < β) : Tendsto (timeChange β) atTop atTop

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.deriv_timeChange_at_zero
theorems.statement: {β : ℝ} (hβ : β ≠ 0) : deriv (timeChange β) 0 = 1

theorems.statement: (N k : ℕ) [NeZero N] (f : Fin k → Fin N) : parentAssignment N k f = (Fintype.card (Fin k → Fin N) : ENNReal)⁻¹

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.ancestralPartitionLaw_eq_map
theorems.statement: (N k : ℕ) [NeZero N] : ancestralPartitionLaw N k = (parentAssignment N k).map ancestralPartition

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.ancestralPartition_eq_bot_iff
theorems.statement: {k N : ℕ} (f : Fin k → Fin N) : ancestralPartition f = ⊥ ↔ Function.Injective f

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.card_quotient_ancestralPartition

theorems.statement: {k N M : ℕ} (f : Fin k → Fin N) (g : Fin N → Fin M) : ancestralPartition f ≤ ancestralPartition (g ∘ f)

theorems.statement: (N k : ℕ) : Fintype.card (Fin k → Fin N) = N ^ k

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.card_injective_parentMaps
theorems.statement: (N k : ℕ) : Fintype.card {f : Fin k → Fin N // Function.Injective f} = N.descFactorial k

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.noCoalescenceProb_zero

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.noCoalescenceProb_one
theorems.statement: {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) : noCoalescenceProb N 1 = 1

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.noCoalescenceProb_two
theorems.statement: {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) : noCoalescenceProb N 2 = 1 - 1 / (N : ℝ)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.noCoalescenceProb_eq_prod
theorems.statement: {N k : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (hkN : k ≤ N) : noCoalescenceProb N k = ∏ i ∈ range k, (1 - (i : ℝ) / (N : ℝ))

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.one_sub_sum_le_prod
theorems.statement: {k : ℕ} (a : ℕ → ℝ) (h0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ a i) (h1 : ∀ i < k, a i ≤ 1) : 1 - ∑ i ∈ range k, a i ≤ ∏ i ∈ range k, (1 - a i)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.prod_le_one_sub_sum_add_sq
theorems.statement: {k : ℕ} (a : ℕ → ℝ) (h0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ a i) (h1 : ∀ i < k, a i ≤ 1) : ∏ i ∈ range k, (1 - a i) ≤ 1 - ∑ i ∈ range k, a i + (∑ i ∈ range k, a i) ^ 2 / 2

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.sum_range_div_eq_deathRate
theorems.statement: (N k : ℕ) : ∑ i ∈ range k, (i : ℝ) / (N : ℝ) = deathRate k / (N : ℝ)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.coalescenceProb_le
theorems.statement: {N k : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (hkN : k ≤ N) : 1 - noCoalescenceProb N k ≤ deathRate k / (N : ℝ)

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.le_coalescenceProb
theorems.statement: {N k : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (hkN : k ≤ N) : deathRate k / (N : ℝ) - (deathRate k / (N : ℝ)) ^ 2 / 2 ≤ 1 - noCoalescenceProb N k

theorems.name: Descent.Coalescent.coalescenceProb_two
theorems.statement: {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) : 1 - noCoalescenceProb N 2 = deathRate 2 / (N : ℝ)

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.explainable_fraction_bound_of_conditional_noise_floor
theorems.statement: (hm : m ≤ mΩ) {L noiseFloor : Ω → ℝ} (hL : MemLp L 2 μ) (hVar_pos : 0 < Var[L; μ]) (hNoise_int : Integrable noiseFloor μ) (hNoise_nonneg : 0 ≤ μ[noiseFloor]) (hNoise_le : noiseFloor ≤ᵐ[μ] conditionalVariance μ m L) : explainableFraction (Var[conditionalMean μ m L; μ]) (Var[L; μ]) ≤ Var[conditionalMean μ m L; μ] / (Var[conditionalMean μ m L; μ] + μ[noiseFloor])

theorems.name: Descent.Foundations.explainable_fraction_bound_of_conditional_gaussian_floor
theorems.statement: (hm : m ≤ mΩ) {L sigma4 : Ω → ℝ} (hL : MemLp L 2 μ) (hVar_pos : 0 < Var[L; μ]) (hsigma4_int : Integrable sigma4 μ) (hsigma4_nonneg : 0 ≤ μ[sigma4]) (hGaussianFloor : (fun ω ↦ (2 : ℝ) * sigma4 ω) ≤ᵐ[μ] conditionalVariance μ m L) : explainableFraction (Var[conditionalMean μ m L; μ]) (Var[L; μ]) ≤ Var[conditionalMean μ m L; μ] / (Var[conditionalMean μ m L; μ] + 2 * μ[sigma4])

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.DeploymentPopulation.eval_phenotype_eq
theorems.statement: : P.E P.phenotype = Foundations.dot P.β (fun l ↦ P.E (fun ω ↦ P.C ω l)) + P.E P.h

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.DeploymentPopulation.outcomeVariance_eq
theorems.statement: : P.outcomeVariance = Foundations.dot P.β (P.sigmaC.mulVec P.β) + 2 * Foundations.dot P.β P.contextC + Foundations.variance P.E P.h

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.DeploymentPopulation.r2_eq
theorems.statement: : P.r2 w = (Foundations.dot w (P.kappa.mulVec P.β) + Foundations.dot w P.contextX) ^ 2 / (Foundations.dot w (P.sigmaX.mulVec w) * (Foundations.dot P.β (P.sigmaC.mulVec P.β) + 2 * Foundations.dot P.β P.contextC + Foundations.variance P.E P.h))

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.DeploymentPopulation.calibrationSlope_eq
theorems.statement: : P.calibrationSlope w = (Foundations.dot w (P.kappa.mulVec P.β) + Foundations.dot w P.contextX) / Foundations.dot w (P.sigmaX.mulVec w)

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.DeploymentPopulation.calibrationIntercept_eq
theorems.statement: : P.calibrationIntercept w = (Foundations.dot P.β (fun l ↦ P.E (fun ω ↦ P.C ω l)) + P.E P.h) - ((Foundations.dot w (P.kappa.mulVec P.β) + Foundations.dot w P.contextX) / Foundations.dot w (P.sigmaX.mulVec w)) * Foundations.dot w (fun j ↦ P.E (fun ω ↦ P.X ω j))

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.DeploymentPopulation.deployedMse_eq
theorems.statement: : P.deployedMse w = (Foundations.dot P.β (P.sigmaC.mulVec P.β) + 2 * Foundations.dot P.β P.contextC + Foundations.variance P.E P.h) + Foundations.dot w (P.sigmaX.mulVec w) - 2 * (Foundations.dot w (P.kappa.mulVec P.β) + Foundations.dot w P.contextX) + (P.E (P.score w) - P.E P.phenotype) ^ 2

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.Deployment.predictiveCovariance_transport

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.Deployment.scoreVariance_transport

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.Deployment.r2_transport_factorisation

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.Deployment.r2_transport_of_no_shift
theorems.statement: (hcov : D.target.predictiveCovariance D.w = D.source.predictiveCovariance D.w) (hvar : D.target.scoreVariance D.w = D.source.scoreVariance D.w) (hout : D.target.outcomeVariance = D.source.outcomeVariance) : D.target.r2 D.w = D.source.r2 D.w

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.Deployment.r2_portable_iff
theorems.statement: (hvS : D.source.scoreVariance D.w ≠ 0) (hoS : D.source.outcomeVariance ≠ 0) (hvT : D.target.scoreVariance D.w ≠ 0) (hoT : D.target.outcomeVariance ≠ 0) : D.target.r2 D.w = D.source.r2 D.w ↔ D.target.predictiveCovariance D.w ^ 2 * (D.source.scoreVariance D.w * D.source.outcomeVariance) = D.source.predictiveCovariance D.w ^ 2 * (D.target.scoreVariance D.w * D.target.outcomeVariance)

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.Deployment.dispersion_shift_lowers_slope_and_r2
theorems.statement: (hcov : D.target.predictiveCovariance D.w = D.source.predictiveCovariance D.w) (hout : D.target.outcomeVariance = D.source.outcomeVariance) (hS : 0 < D.source.scoreVariance D.w) (hgrow : D.source.scoreVariance D.w < D.target.scoreVariance D.w) (hcovpos : 0 < D.source.predictiveCovariance D.w) (houtpos : 0 < D.source.outcomeVariance) : D.target.calibrationSlope D.w < D.source.calibrationSlope D.w ∧ D.target.r2 D.w < D.source.r2 D.w

theorems.name: Descent.Portability.metrics_eq_of_statistic_eq
theorems.statement: {ΩS ΩT J' L₁ L₂ : Type*} [Fintype J'] [DecidableEq J'] [Fintype L₁] [DecidableEq L₁] [Fintype L₂] [DecidableEq L₂] (P : DeploymentPopulation ΩS J' L₁) (Q : DeploymentPopulation ΩT J' L₂) (w v : J' → ℝ) (hstat : portabilityStatistic P w = portabilityStatistic Q v) : P.r2 w = Q.r2 v ∧ P.calibrationSlope w = Q.calibrationSlope v

theorems.statement: {Group : Type*} [Fintype Group] [DecidableEq Group] (p : Descent.Core.PopGenParameters) (V_E : ℝ) (hE : 0 ≤ V_E) (hflow : 0 < p.mu + p.mig) (divergence : Group → Group → ℝ) (s t : Group) (htwin : Blindness.IsProfileTwin divergence s t) (hsymm : ∀ a b, divergence a b = divergence b a) (a b : Group) : Descent.Core.ScoreMoments.deployedR2 p V_E = Descent.Core.share (Descent.Core.retainedFraction p.fstEquilibrium p.V_A) V_E ∧ divergence (Equiv.swap s t a) (Equiv.swap s t b) = divergence a b

theorems.name: Descent.Program.neutralDriftFactor_uses_timeScale
theorems.statement: (Ne : ℝ) (t : ℕ) : Portability.neutralDriftFactor Ne t = (1 - 1 / coalescentTimeScale Ne) ^ t

theorems.name: Descent.Program.ldRetainedFraction_uses_timeScale
theorems.statement: (r Ne : ℝ) (t : ℕ) : PopGen.ldRetainedFraction r Ne t = ((1 - r) * (1 - 1 / coalescentTimeScale Ne)) ^ t

theorems.name: Descent.Program.heterozygosityLossFromDrift_uses_timeScale
theorems.statement: (Ne : ℝ) (t : ℕ) : PopGen.heterozygosityLossFromDrift t Ne = 1 - (1 - 1 / coalescentTimeScale Ne) ^ t

theorems.name: Descent.Program.wrightFisherDriftRetention_uses_timeScale
theorems.statement: (N : ℕ) (t : ℕ) : Portability.wrightFisherDriftRetention N t = (1 - 1 / coalescentTimeScale (N : ℝ)) ^ t

theorems.name: Descent.Program.coalescentTau_uses_timeScale
theorems.statement: (t Ne : ℝ) : Portability.coalescentTau t Ne = t / coalescentTimeScale Ne

theorems.name: Descent.Program.EvolutionaryParameters_theta_eq_ploidy_form
theorems.statement: (p : PopGen.EvolutionaryParameters) : PopGen.EvolutionaryParameters.theta p = 2 * Descent.Core.ploidy * p.Ne * p.mu

theorems.name: Descent.Program.EvolutionaryParameters_bigM_eq_ploidy_form
theorems.statement: (p : PopGen.EvolutionaryParameters) : PopGen.EvolutionaryParameters.bigM p = 2 * Descent.Core.ploidy * p.Ne * p.mig

theorems.name: Descent.Program.Var_Delta_Mu_eq_ploidy_form
theorems.statement: (V_A fst : ℝ) : Portability.Var_Delta_Mu V_A fst = Descent.Core.ploidy * fst * V_A

theorems.name: Descent.Program.pgsDriftVariance_one_pop_eq_ploidy_form
theorems.statement: (V_A fst : ℝ) : PopGen.pgsDriftVariance_one_pop V_A fst = Descent.Core.ploidy * fst * V_A

theorems.name: Descent.Program.pgsDriftVariance_one_pop_eq_Var_Delta_Mu
theorems.statement: (V_A fst : ℝ) : PopGen.pgsDriftVariance_one_pop V_A fst = Portability.Var_Delta_Mu V_A fst

theorems.name: Descent.Program.pgsVariance_uses_hwe
theorems.statement: {m : ℕ} (β p : Fin m → ℝ) : Portability.pgsVariance β p = ∑ i, β i ^ 2 * hweGenotypeVariance (p i)

theorems.name: Descent.Program.dominanceVariance_uses_hwe
theorems.statement: {m : ℕ} (p d : Fin m → ℝ) : PopGen.dominanceVariance p d = ∑ i, (hweGenotypeVariance (p i) * d i) ^ 2

theorems.name: Descent.Program.additiveVariance_uses_hwe
theorems.statement: {m : ℕ} (p α : Fin m → ℝ) : PopGen.additiveVariance p α = ∑ i, hweGenotypeVariance (p i) * (α i) ^ 2

theorems.name: Descent.Program.noncentralityParam_uses_hwe
theorems.statement: (n : ℕ) (beta p : ℝ) : Decision.noncentralityParam n beta p = n * beta ^ 2 * hweGenotypeVariance p

theorems.name: Descent.Program.gwasNCP_uses_hwe
theorems.statement: (n : ℕ) (β p : ℝ) : PopGen.gwasNCP n β p = n * β ^ 2 * hweGenotypeVariance p

theorems.name: Descent.Program.effectiveFisherInformation_uses_hwe
theorems.statement: (n : ℕ) (p r2_ld : ℝ) : Portability.effectiveFisherInformation n p r2_ld = n * hweGenotypeVariance p * r2_ld

theorems.name: Descent.Program.epistaticVariancePairwise_uses_hwe
theorems.statement: (γ p₁ p₂ : ℝ) : Portability.epistaticVariancePairwise γ p₁ p₂ = γ ^ 2 * hweGenotypeVariance p₁ * hweGenotypeVariance p₂

theorems.name: Descent.Program.expectedPGSDiffVariance_eq_ploidy_form
theorems.statement: (V_A fst : ℝ) : PopGen.expectedPGSDiffVariance V_A fst = Descent.Core.ploidy * Descent.Core.ploidy * fst * V_A

theorems.name: Descent.Program.ldHalfLife_uses_timeScale
theorems.statement: (r Ne : ℝ) : PopGen.ldHalfLife r Ne = Real.log 2 / (-Real.log ((1 - r) * (1 - 1 / coalescentTimeScale Ne)))

theorems.name: Descent.Program.cumulativeDrift_uses_timeScale
theorems.statement: {T : ℕ} (Ne : Fin T → ℝ) : PopGen.cumulativeDrift Ne = ∑ i, 1 / coalescentTimeScale (Ne i)

theorems.name: Descent.Program.ldRetentionPerGen_uses_timeScale
theorems.statement: (r Ne : ℝ) : PopGen.ldRetentionPerGen r Ne = (1 - r) * (1 - 1 / coalescentTimeScale Ne)

theorems.name: Descent.Program.hetDecayFactor_uses_timeScale
theorems.statement: (Ne θ : ℝ) : PopGen.hetDecayFactor Ne θ = (1 - 1 / coalescentTimeScale Ne) * (1 - θ / coalescentTimeScale Ne)

theorems.name: Descent.Program.fstTransientDecayFromScaled_uses_timeScale
theorems.statement: (Ne θ bigM : ℝ) : PopGen.fstTransientDecayFromScaled Ne θ bigM = PopGen.hetDecayFromScaled Ne θ * (1 - bigM / coalescentTimeScale Ne)

theorems.name: Descent.Program.asymmetricFst_eq_scaled
theorems.statement: (Ne m₁₂ m₂₁ : ℝ) : Portability.asymmetricFst Ne m₁₂ m₂₁ = PopGen.fstMutationDriftEquilibrium (Descent.Core.scaledMigrationRate Ne (m₁₂ + m₂₁))

theorems.name: Descent.Program.fstMigrationMutationEquilibriumManyDemes_eq_scaled
theorems.statement: (Ne m μ : ℝ) : PopGen.fstMigrationMutationEquilibriumManyDemes Ne m μ = 1 / (1 + Descent.Core.scaledMigrationRate Ne m + Descent.Core.scaledMutationRate Ne μ)

theorems.name: Descent.Program.fstIslandEquilibriumFiniteDemes_eq_scaled
theorems.statement: (Ne m μ nDemes : ℝ) : PopGen.fstIslandEquilibriumFiniteDemes Ne m μ nDemes = 1 / (1 + Descent.Core.scaledMigrationRate Ne m * Descent.Core.islandDemeCorrection nDemes + Descent.Core.scaledMutationRate Ne μ)

theorems.name: Descent.Program.expectedFreqDiffSq_uses_hwe
theorems.statement: (fst p0 : ℝ) : PopGen.expectedFreqDiffSq fst p0 = fst * hweGenotypeVariance p0

theorems.name: Descent.Program.pgsMean_uses_ploidy
theorems.statement: {m : ℕ} (β p : Fin m → ℝ) : Portability.pgsMean β p = ∑ i, β i * (Descent.Core.ploidy * p i)

theorems.name: Descent.Program.fisherAverageEffect_uses_ploidy
theorems.statement: (a d p : ℝ) : PopGen.fisherAverageEffect a d p = a + d * (1 - Descent.Core.ploidy * p)

theorems.name: Descent.Program.selectedDriftFactor_uses_timeScale
theorems.statement: (Ne : ℝ) (t : ℕ) (s_correction : ℝ) : Portability.selectedDriftFactor Ne t s_correction = (1 - 1 / coalescentTimeScale Ne + s_correction) ^ t

theorems.name: Descent.Program.SplitMigrationModel_scaledMigration_eq_ploidy_form
theorems.statement: (m : Portability.SplitMigrationModel) : Descent.Core.scaledMigrationRate m.Ne m.mig = 2 * Descent.Core.ploidy * m.Ne * m.mig

theorems.name: Descent.Program.fstMigDriftNext_uses_timeScale
theorems.statement: (Ne m Fst : ℝ) : Portability.fstMigDriftNext Ne m Fst = (1 - 2 * m - 1 / coalescentTimeScale Ne) * Fst + 1 / coalescentTimeScale Ne

theorems.name: Descent.Program.ibdFst_eq_ploidy_form
theorems.statement: (d N sigma_sq : ℝ) : PopGen.ibdFst d N sigma_sq = d / (2 * Descent.Core.ploidy * N * sigma_sq + d)

theorems.name: Descent.Program.EvolutionaryParameters_tau_uses_timeScale
theorems.statement: (p : PopGen.EvolutionaryParameters) : PopGen.EvolutionaryParameters.tau p = p.t_div / coalescentTimeScale p.Ne

theorems.name: Descent.Program.sharedLDRetention_uses_ploidy
theorems.statement: (p : PopGen.EvolutionaryParameters) : PopGen.sharedLDRetention p = (1 - p.recomb) ^ (Descent.Core.ploidy * p.t_div)

theorems.name: Descent.Program.demoSteppingStoneFst_eq_scaled
theorems.statement: (d Ne m σ_sq : ℝ) : PopGen.demoSteppingStoneFst d Ne m σ_sq = d / (d + Descent.Core.scaledMigrationRate Ne m * σ_sq)

theorems.name: Descent.Program.tauAt_uses_timeScale
theorems.statement: (g : Descent.Core.PopGenParameters) (t : ℕ) : Descent.Core.PopGenParameters.tauAt g t = (t : ℝ) / coalescentTimeScale g.Ne

theorems.name: Descent.Program.alleleFreqDivergenceRate_eq_scaled
theorems.statement: (Ne mu m_rate : ℝ) : PopGen.alleleFreqDivergenceRate Ne mu m_rate = 1 / coalescentTimeScale Ne

theorems.name: Descent.Program.fstMutationDriftTransient_uses_timeScale
theorems.statement: (θ t Ne : ℝ) : PopGen.fstMutationDriftTransient θ t Ne = PopGen.fstMutationDriftEquilibrium θ * (1 - Real.exp (-(1 + θ) * t / coalescentTimeScale Ne))

theorems.name: Descent.Program.MutationDriftModelAssumptions_fstTransient_uses_timeScale
theorems.statement: (m : Portability.MutationDriftModelAssumptions) : Portability.MutationDriftModelAssumptions.fstTransient m = m.fstEquilibrium * (1 - Real.exp (-(1 + m.theta) * m.t / coalescentTimeScale m.Ne))

theorems.name: Descent.Program.hetMutationDriftRecurrence_step_uses_timeScale
theorems.statement: (Ne mu H₀ : ℝ) (t : ℕ) : PopGen.hetMutationDriftRecurrence Ne mu H₀ (t + 1) = (1 - 1 / coalescentTimeScale Ne) * PopGen.hetMutationDriftRecurrence Ne mu H₀ t + Descent.Core.ploidy * mu * (1 - PopGen.hetMutationDriftRecurrence Ne mu H₀ t)

theorems.name: Descent.Program.hetMutationFloor_eq_scaled
theorems.statement: (Ne mu : ℝ) : Portability.hetMutationFloor Ne mu = Descent.Core.scaledMutationRate Ne mu / (1 + Descent.Core.scaledMutationRate Ne mu)

theorems.name: Descent.Program.presentDayPGSVariance_eq_retainedFraction
theorems.statement: (V_A fst : ℝ) : Portability.presentDayPGSVariance V_A fst = Descent.Core.retainedFraction fst V_A

theorems.name: Descent.Program.heterozygosityLossFromDrift_eq_closedPopulation_measuredLoss
theorems.statement: (t : ℕ) (Ne H₀ : ℝ) (hH : 0 < H₀) : PopGen.heterozygosityLossFromDrift t Ne = (PopGen.closedPopulation Ne H₀ hH).measuredLoss t

theorems.name: Descent.Program.wrightFisherHeterozygosityLoss_eq_closedPopulation_measuredLoss
theorems.statement: (N t : ℕ) (H₀ : ℝ) (hH : 0 < H₀) : Portability.wrightFisherHeterozygosityLoss N t = (PopGen.closedPopulation (N : ℝ) H₀ hH).measuredLoss t

theorems.name: Descent.Program.pcTargetAxisEfficacy_eq_proportionalReduction
theorems.statement: (residual baseline : ℝ) : Portability.pcTargetAxisEfficacy baseline residual = PopGen.fstFromHetRatio residual baseline ∧ Portability.pcTargetAxisEfficacy baseline residual = Portability.hudsonFstFromCoalescenceTimes residual baseline ∧ Portability.pcTargetAxisEfficacy baseline residual = PopGen.r2FromMSE residual baseline

theorems.name: Descent.Program.slatkin_hetRatio_eq_coalescenceRatio
theorems.statement: (Hw Hb ETw ETb : ℝ) (h : Hw / Hb = ETw / ETb) : PopGen.fstFromHetRatio Hw Hb = Portability.hudsonFstFromCoalescenceTimes ETw ETb

theorems.name: Descent.Program.effectiveSampleSizeFromSE_uses_hweGenotypeVariance
theorems.statement: (se p : ℝ) : Portability.effectiveSampleSizeFromSE se p = 1 / (se ^ 2 * hweGenotypeVariance p)

theorems.name: Descent.Program.hetStepWithMutation_uses_coalescentTimeScale
theorems.statement: (Ne mu H : ℝ) : Portability.hetStepWithMutation Ne mu H = (1 - 1 / coalescentTimeScale Ne) * H + Descent.Core.ploidy * mu * (1 - H)

theorems.name: Descent.Program.retention_uses_coalescentTimeScale
theorems.statement: (r : Portability.ClosedPopulationNoMutation) : r.retention = (1 - 1 / coalescentTimeScale r.Ne) ^ r.horizon

theorems.name: Descent.Program.ibdFlowStep_uses_coalescentTimeScale
theorems.statement: (Ne rate F : ℝ) : Portability.ibdFlowStep Ne rate F = F + (1 - F) / coalescentTimeScale Ne - Descent.Core.ploidy * rate * F

theorems.name: Descent.Program.ibdRecurrenceStep_uses_coalescentTimeScale
theorems.statement: (Ne rate x : ℝ) : Portability.ibdRecurrenceStep Ne rate x = (1 - rate) ^ 2 * (1 / coalescentTimeScale Ne + (1 - 1 / coalescentTimeScale Ne) * x)

theorems.name: Descent.Program.ibdRecurrenceFixedPoint_uses_coalescentTimeScale
theorems.statement: (Ne rate : ℝ) : Portability.ibdRecurrenceFixedPoint Ne rate = (1 - rate) ^ 2 / ((1 - rate) ^ 2 + coalescentTimeScale Ne * rate * (Descent.Core.ploidy - rate))

theorems.name: Descent.Program.hetDecayFromScaled_uses_coalescentTimeScale
theorems.statement: (Ne θ : ℝ) : PopGen.hetDecayFromScaled Ne θ = (1 - 1 / coalescentTimeScale Ne) * (1 - θ / coalescentTimeScale Ne)

theorems.name: Descent.Program.fstDriftFlowStep_uses_coalescentTimeScale
theorems.statement: (p : PopGen.EvolutionaryParameters) (F : ℝ) : PopGen.fstDriftFlowStep p F = F + (1 - F) / coalescentTimeScale p.Ne - Descent.Core.ploidy * (p.mig + p.mu) * F

theorems.name: Descent.Program.fstDemeCorrectedFlowStep_uses_coalescentTimeScale
theorems.statement: (p : PopGen.EvolutionaryParameters) (F : ℝ) : PopGen.fstDemeCorrectedFlowStep p F = F + (1 - F) / coalescentTimeScale p.Ne - Descent.Core.ploidy * (Descent.Core.islandDemeCorrection 2 * p.mig + p.mu) * F

theorems.name: Descent.Program.averageEffect_uses_ploidy
theorems.statement: (m : Blindness.OneLocusArchitecture) : m.averageEffect = m.a + m.d * (1 - Descent.Core.ploidy * m.p)

theorems.name: Descent.Program.polygenicAdaptationShift_uses_ploidy
theorems.statement: {m : ℕ} (β Δp : Fin m → ℝ) : PopGen.polygenicAdaptationShift β Δp = ∑ i, β i * Descent.Core.ploidy * Δp i

theorems.name: Descent.Program.steppingStoneFstQuadratic_uses_ploidy
theorems.statement: (d Ne m σ_sq : ℝ) : PopGen.steppingStoneFstQuadratic d Ne m σ_sq = d / (d + 2 * Descent.Core.ploidy * Ne * σ_sq ^ 2 * m ^ 2)

theorems.name: Descent.Program.driftLDStep_uses_coalescentTimeScale
theorems.statement: (Ne c Q : ℝ) : PopGen.driftLDStep Ne c Q = (1 - c) ^ 2 * (1 / coalescentTimeScale Ne + (1 - 1 / coalescentTimeScale Ne) * Q)

theorems.name: Descent.Program.driftLDRetention_uses_coalescentTimeScale
theorems.statement: (Ne c : ℝ) : PopGen.driftLDRetention Ne c = (1 - c) ^ 2 * (1 - 1 / coalescentTimeScale Ne)

theorems.name: Descent.Program.driftLDEquilibrium_uses_coalescentTimeScale
theorems.statement: (Ne c : ℝ) : PopGen.driftLDEquilibrium Ne c = (1 - c) ^ 2 * (1 / coalescentTimeScale Ne) / (1 - PopGen.driftLDRetention Ne c)

theorems.name: Descent.Program.ohtaKimuraSigmaDSq_uses_ploidy
theorems.statement: (Ne c : ℝ) : PopGen.ohtaKimuraSigmaDSq Ne c = (10 + 2 * Descent.Core.ploidy * Ne * c) / ((2 + 2 * Descent.Core.ploidy * Ne * c) * (11 + 2 * Descent.Core.ploidy * Ne * c))

theorems.name: Descent.Program.islandFstFiniteDemes_eq_scaled
theorems.statement: (Ne m d : ℝ) : PopGen.islandFstFiniteDemes Ne m d = PopGen.fstMutationDriftEquilibrium (Descent.Core.scaledMigrationRate Ne m * Descent.Core.islandDemeCorrection d)

theorems.name: Descent.Program.steppingStoneCharacteristicLength_uses_ploidy
theorems.statement: (m σ_sq μ : ℝ) : PopGen.steppingStoneCharacteristicLength m σ_sq μ = Real.sqrt (m * σ_sq / (Descent.Core.ploidy * μ))

theorems.name: Descent.Program.serialFounderWithinTime_uses_coalescentTimeScale
theorems.statement: (N Nanc tAnc : ℝ) : PopGen.serialFounderWithinTime N Nanc tAnc = coalescentTimeScale N * (1 - Real.exp (-tAnc / coalescentTimeScale N)) + Real.exp (-tAnc / coalescentTimeScale N) * coalescentTimeScale Nanc

theorems.name: Descent.Program.neiGst_at_fold
theorems.statement: (p : ℝ) : neiGst p (1 - p) = (1 - Descent.Core.ploidy * p) ^ 2

theorems.name: Descent.Program.mOne_mul_mTwo_eq_neiGst_at_fold
theorems.statement: (p : ℝ) : Blindness.BundleRigidity.mOne p * Blindness.BundleRigidity.mTwo p = neiGst p (1 - p) / (p * (1 - p))

theorems.name: Descent.Program.importanceWeightESS_eq_momentPermeability
theorems.statement: (sum_w sum_w_sq : ℝ) : Portability.importanceWeightESS sum_w sum_w_sq = Spectral.momentPermeability sum_w sum_w_sq

theorems.name: Descent.Program.driftVariance_uses_hweGenotypeVariance
theorems.statement: (p0 fst : ℝ) : PopGen.driftVariance p0 fst = hweGenotypeVariance p0 * fst / Descent.Core.ploidy

theorems.name: Descent.Program.realWorldPGSVariance_eq_retainedFraction
theorems.statement: (V_A fst rhoSq : ℝ) : Portability.realWorldPGSVariance V_A fst rhoSq = rhoSq * Descent.Core.retainedFraction fst V_A

theorems.name: Descent.Program.scalar_summary_insufficient_for_accuracy
theorems.statement: {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V] (distance accuracy : V →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (hnot : ¬ ∃ c : ℝ, accuracy = c • distance) : ∀ θ : V, ∃ θ' : V, distance θ' = distance θ ∧ accuracy θ' ≠ accuracy θ

theorems.name: Descent.Program.between_group_variance_fraction_le_one
theorems.statement: (varZ eVarZgivenD varEZgivenD : ℝ) (h_decomp : varZ = eVarZgivenD + varEZgivenD) (h_varZ_pos : 0 < varZ) (h_eVar_nonneg : 0 ≤ eVarZgivenD) : varEZgivenD / varZ ≤ 1

theorems.name: Descent.Program.div_le_of_ge_one_sub_mul
theorems.statement: (varZ eVarZgivenD varEZgivenD δ : ℝ) (h_decomp : varZ = eVarZgivenD + varEZgivenD) (h_varZ_pos : 0 < varZ) (h_within_dominates : eVarZgivenD ≥ (1 - δ) * varZ) : varEZgivenD / varZ ≤ δ

theorems.name: Descent.Program.comparable_covariates_both_small
theorems.statement: (r2_d r2_s B ε : ℝ) (h_comparable : r2_d ≤ r2_s + ε) (h_sum_bound : r2_d + r2_s ≤ B) : r2_d ≤ (B + ε) / 2

theorems.name: Descent.Program.two_mul_one_sub_lt_of_lt_of_le_half
theorems.statement: (p₁ p₂ : ℝ) (hp₁_lt_p₂ : p₁ < p₂) (hp₂_le_half : p₂ ≤ 1 / 2) : 2 * p₁ * (1 - p₁) < 2 * p₂ * (1 - p₂)

theorems.name: Descent.Program.two_term_weighted_sum_lt_of_larger_weight_gain
theorems.statement: (βL βS pL pL' pS pS' : ℝ) (hβ : βS ^ 2 ≤ βL ^ 2) (hβL : 0 < βL ^ 2) (hsmall_loses : pS' * (1 - pS') ≤ pS * (1 - pS)) (hlarge_gains_more : pS * (1 - pS) - pS' * (1 - pS') < pL' * (1 - pL') - pL * (1 - pL)) : 2 * βS ^ 2 * (pS * (1 - pS)) + 2 * βL ^ 2 * (pL * (1 - pL)) < 2 * βS ^ 2 * (pS' * (1 - pS')) + 2 * βL ^ 2 * (pL' * (1 - pL'))

theorems.name: Descent.Program.compound_r2_drop
theorems.statement: (cov_s cov_t vpgs_s vpgs_t vy : ℝ) (h_cov_drop : cov_t ^ 2 < cov_s ^ 2) (h_vpgs_up : vpgs_s < vpgs_t) (h_vy_pos : 0 < vy) (h_vpgs_pos : 0 < vpgs_s) : cov_t ^ 2 / (vpgs_t * vy) < cov_s ^ 2 / (vpgs_s * vy)

theorems.name: Descent.Program.sign_flip_z_decreases_with_turnover
theorems.statement: (β σ ρ₁ ρ₂ : ℝ) (hβ : 0 < β) (hσ : 0 < σ) (hρ : ρ₂ < ρ₁) : ρ₂ * β / σ < ρ₁ * β / σ

theorems.name: Descent.Program.binary_precision_formula_exact
theorems.statement: (c : Foundations.ConfusionMatrix) : Foundations.ConfusionMatrix.precision c = (Foundations.ConfusionMatrix.prevalence c * Foundations.ConfusionMatrix.recallRate c) / (Foundations.ConfusionMatrix.prevalence c * Foundations.ConfusionMatrix.recallRate c + (1 - Foundations.ConfusionMatrix.prevalence c) * Foundations.ConfusionMatrix.fpr c)

theorems.name: Descent.Program.precision_recall_divergence_exists
theorems.statement: : ∃ (π p r₁ r₂ f₁ f₂ : ℝ), 0 < π ∧ π < 1 ∧ 0 < p ∧ p < 1 ∧ 0 < r₁ ∧ r₁ < r₂ ∧ r₂ ≤ 1 ∧ f₁ = π * r₁ * (1 - p) / ((1 - π) * p) ∧ f₂ = π * r₂ * (1 - p) / ((1 - π) * p) ∧ (π * r₁) / (π * r₁ + (1 - π) * f₁) = p ∧ (π * r₂) / (π * r₂ + (1 - π) * f₂) = p

theorems.name: Descent.Program.env_variance_lowers_r2
theorems.statement: (Vg Ve₁ Ve₂ : ℝ) (hVg : 0 < Vg) (hVe₁ : 0 < Ve₁) (h_more_env : Ve₁ < Ve₂) : Vg / (Vg + Ve₂) < Vg / (Vg + Ve₁)

theorems.name: Descent.Program.omitted_variable_bias
theorems.statement: (β_true β_ses ρ : ℝ) (h_ses : β_ses ≠ 0) (h_corr : ρ ≠ 0) : β_true + β_ses * ρ ≠ β_true

theorems.name: Descent.Program.both_le_of_add_eq_of_nonneg
theorems.statement: (r2s r2t Δg Δe : ℝ) (h_eq : r2s - r2t = Δg + Δe) (hΔg : 0 ≤ Δg) (hΔe : 0 ≤ Δe) : Δg ≤ r2s - r2t ∧ Δe ≤ r2s - r2t

theorems.name: Descent.Program.prediction_error_decomp
theorems.statement: (β δ ρ : ℝ) : (β + δ) - ρ * β = (1 - ρ) * β + δ

theorems.name: Descent.Program.relative_error_increases_with_turnover
theorems.statement: (β δ ρ₁ ρ₂ : ℝ) (hβ : 0 < β) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hρ₁ : 0 < ρ₁) (hρ₂ : 0 < ρ₂) (hρ : ρ₂ < ρ₁) : ((1 - ρ₁) * β + δ) / (ρ₁ * β) < ((1 - ρ₂) * β + δ) / (ρ₂ * β)

theorems.name: Descent.Program.mul_lt_mul_left_of_pos'
theorems.statement: (beta_sq H_s H_t : ℝ) (hβ : 0 < beta_sq) (hH : H_s < H_t) : beta_sq * H_s < beta_sq * H_t

theorems.name: Descent.Program.variance_decomposition
theorems.statement: {m : ℕ} (w : Fin m → ℝ) (S : Finset (Fin m)) : ∑ i, w i = ∑ i ∈ S, w i + ∑ i ∈ Sᶜ, w i

theorems.name: Descent.Program.sum_lt_sum_of_net_gain_on_subset
theorems.statement: {m : ℕ} (w_s w_t : Fin m → ℝ) (S : Finset (Fin m)) (h_net : (∑ i ∈ S, w_t i) - (∑ i ∈ S, w_s i) > (∑ i ∈ Sᶜ, w_s i) - (∑ i ∈ Sᶜ, w_t i)) : ∑ i, w_s i < ∑ i, w_t i

theorems.name: Descent.Program.closer_to_half_more_uncertainty
theorems.statement: (π₁ π₂ : ℝ) (h_closer : (π₂ - 1/2) ^ 2 < (π₁ - 1/2) ^ 2) : π₁ * (1 - π₁) < π₂ * (1 - π₂)

theorems.name: Descent.Program.interval_width_increases
